g.text: CD2 — Agent Layer (the AI part of the system)
A workflow builds the task → the orchestrator talks to the LLM and runs tools → the parser turns the reply into objects → the guardrails check them.
1. Workflows — one per AI feature (Template Method)
4. Tools the LLM may call (all read-only)
Subclasses only fill in steps 2, 4 (and optionally 1, 5).
+search(eventId : UUID, q : String, k : int) : List<DocumentChunk>
